what: The proposed collector outer-launcher test says to set OUTER_LAUNCHER to an argv-recording stub, but the collector only accepts the canonical scripts/launch-review.sh path and rejects other launchers before retry.
scenario_or_breakage: Following the plan literally either fails the new test with Retry metadata invalid: OUTER_LAUNCHER not canonical launch-review.sh or pressures the implementation to weaken the canonical-launcher guard.
suggested_fix: Keep OUTER_LAUNCHER=$REPO_ROOT/scripts/launch-review.sh in the test and assert forwarding via existing PATH-stubbed leaf CLI behavior or sink-file effects instead of replacing the outer launcher with a stub.

what: The plan captures --risk only for OUTER_LAUNCHER_RISK metadata, but launch-review still ignores the parsed risk when choosing Codex effort and Cursor max-mode.
scenario_or_breakage: A collector retry with OUTER_LAUNCHER_RISK=low invokes launch-review.sh --risk low, yet Codex still calls agent-model-args.sh --with-effort and Cursor still wraps with /max-mode on, so the plan's caller's risk-gated effort claim remains false while the proposed meta-only test passes.
suggested_fix: Use the captured RISK in both launch-review lanes: omit Codex --with-effort and skip Cursor max-mode wrapping for risk=low, or narrow the plan/docs/tests to claim metadata preservation only rather than risk-gated effort preservation.
